desc: Derive the closed-form rule: minimum is m + number of pure nontrivial cycles, impossible only when a pure cycle exists and no buffer can be created (all 26 letters appear and all indegrees are 1).
Implement the Python solution with O(N + 26) time using the rule above, reading stdin and writing stdout.
Verify the implementation on the samples and key edge cases (identity, inconsistent mapping, pure/non-pure cycles, all-26 permutation, buffer creation).
